confirm.what: What every item weighs, and how much each backpack holds
confirm.why: The game puts weight at the top of the inventory screen beside the value and it decides how fast you move, and a bag is chosen for what fits in it. Weight goes on the line in tools/build-armory.js as 3.4kg after the price and nothing else changes; capacity has nowhere to live yet.

work.why: slotOf classifies by name, and what it cannot place becomes 'other', which no shelf shows. They are reachable in the armory and unpickable in a kit.

work.why: Under about 12 two colours stop being distinguishable. It is a fill against a badge rather than two lines, so it is milder than the fault and route pair that was fixed, but it is the closest pair left on the planner canvas.
